**UI Audit: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free (Stop Search Dialog)**

### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window Context:** 1024x768 maximized window. The main application is dimmed (modal overlay).
*   **Modal Dialog (Center):**
    *   **Bounds:** Approx [230, 160] to [750, 650] (Width ~520px, Height ~490px). Centered horizontally and vertically.
    *   **Internal Layout:** Vertical stack.
        *   **Header Area:** Close 'X' icon (top-right).
        *   **Icon Area:** Central illustration (folder + pause icon).
        *   **Title:** "Stop Searching for Lost Data?" (Centered, bold).
        *   **Stats Grid:** Two-column layout for "Files found" and "Used time". Separated by a subtle vertical divider.
        *   **Description:** Multi-line informational text block.
        *   **Action Bar:** Two buttons ("Stop", "Continue") aligned to the center/right.
*   **Background App Regions (Visible behind overlay):**
    *   **Top Header/Nav:** [0, 0] to [1024, 115]. Contains App Title, Buy button, Navigation icons, Filter/Search bar.
    *   **Sidebar (Tree View):** [0, 116] to [230, 820]. Lists drives/folders.
    *   **Main Content (List View):** [231, 116] to [800, 820]. File list with columns (Name, Date Modified, Type).
    *   **Preview Pane (Right):** [801, 116] to [1024, 820]. Shows folder preview details.
    *   **Status/Footer Bar:** [0, 821] to [1024, 940]. Scanning progress strip.

### 2) TEXT
*   **Dialog Title:** `Stop Searching for Lost Data?`
*   **Stat Left (Value):** `1139164`
*   **Stat Left (Label):** `Files found`
*   **Stat Right (Value):** `00:02:38`
*   **Stat Right (Label):** `Used time`
*   **Body Text:** `Remaining data can be rescanned and recovered anytime later, but continuing now save you time.`
*   **Button Left:** `Stop`
*   **Button Right:** `Continue`
*   **App Header:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`, `Buy Now`, `Filter`, `Search files or folders`
*   **Sidebar Items:** `Windows (C:)`, `File Path Lost`, `Reconstructed`
*   **List Columns:** `Path`, `Type`, `Name`, `Date Modified`
*   **List Items:** `Julia` (File folder), `mingw32` (File folder)
*   **Status Bar (Left):** `Searching: ...00040000000A9FB273B246C9\Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.resources.dll`
*   **Status Bar (Center-Left):** `22%`, `Advanced Scanning , Files Found: 1139164 (146.29 GB)`
*   **Status Bar (Bottom-Left):** `||` (Pause Icon), `Remaining time: 10m02s`, `Reading sector: 66453504/313413598`
*   **Status Button (Right):** `Recover All ...`

### 3) COLOR
*   **Dialog Background:** `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Overlay/Dimmer:** `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)` (Dark transparent grey over main app)
*   **Primary Accent (Blue):** `#1677FF` (Approx standard Windows Blue - used for "Continue" button)
*   **Destructive/Accent (Red/Pink):** `#FFEBE6` (Bg of Stop btn), `#CF1322` (Text of Stop btn - estimated)
*   **Text Primary:** `#1F1F1F` (Near Black)
*   **Text Secondary:** `#666666` or `#8C8C8C` (Grey for labels/descriptions)
*   **Stats Value Text:** `#1F1F1F` (Bold, large)
*   **Divider Line (Vertical):** `#E8E8E8` (Light Grey)
*   **App Background (Main):** `#F5F5F5` (Light Grey)
*   **Header Background:** `#E6E6E6` or similar light gradient (Standard Windows titlebar style)

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Dialog Title:** Sans-Serif (Segoe UI/Inter), ~18px, **Bold** (600/700).
*   **Stats Values:** Sans-Serif, ~28-32px, **Bold**, Monospaced or Tabular numbers (for alignment).
*   **Stats Labels:** Sans-Serif, ~12-13px, Regular (400), Grey.
*   **Body Text:** Sans-Serif, ~13px, Regular (400), Line height ~1.5.
*   **Buttons:** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Medium (500).

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Dialog Padding:** ~30-40px internal padding on all sides.
*   **Button Dimensions:** Width ~100-120px, Height ~36-40px. Border Radius ~4-6px.
*   **Gap between Buttons:** ~12-16px.
*   **Stats Container:** Height ~80-90px. Vertical divider centered.
*   **Icon Size (Illustration):** ~80x80px area.
*   **Close Icon ('X'):** ~16x16px, top-right corner offset ~15px.
*   **Progress Bar (Bottom):** Height ~60-70px full width strip.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Modal Dialog:** Active/Focus state. Blocking interaction with background.
*   **Button "Stop":** Normal state. Light red background, red text. (Implies Destructive/Cancel action).
*   **Button "Continue":** Normal state. Solid blue background, white text. (Implies Primary/Affirmative action).
*   **Close Button ('X'):** Top right of dialog.
*   **Background Controls (Disabled/Dimmed):**
    *   Tree view items (Collapsed/Expanded states visible but inactive).
    *   File List (Checkboxes, file names).
    *   "Recover All..." button (Blue, bottom right).
    *   Pause/Stop controls in status bar (Visible behind dialog).

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, filled, colorful vector illustrations (typical modern Windows app style).
*   **Main Illustration:** A blue/grey folder with documents sticking out, overlaid with a yellow/orange circle containing two vertical bars (**Pause** icon). This visually reinforces the "Stop/Pause" context.
*   **Close Icon:** Simple 'X' outline or thin stroke.
*   **App Icons (Header):** Home, Back, Forward, Refresh (standard navigation).
*   **Status Icons:** Pause bars (`||`), Clock/History icon next to "Recover All".

### 8) STATE
*   **Page State:** **Interrupted Processing / Modal Confirmation**.
*   **Context:** The application was in an **"Advanced Scanning"** phase (22% complete, finding files). The user has likely clicked a "Stop" or "Pause" button in the UI (or the system is prompting), triggering this modal to confirm if they want to halt the deep scan or let it continue.
*   **Data State:** Partial results available (1.13M files found so far).
*   **Motion Cues:** None explicitly animated in the static frame, but the "Scanning..." text implies background activity (paused by modal).
